# sveevee

sveevee is a local discovery platform for people, local businesses, and communities. Users can discover nearby ads, SEO-optimized public business pages, community pages, products, services, events, ratings, and direct chat by city and neighborhood.

## Main Links

- [Homepage](https://sveevee.co.il/)
- [Search](https://sveevee.co.il/search)
- [Privacy Policy](https://sveevee.co.il/privacy)
- [Sitemap](https://sveevee.co.il/sitemap.xml)

## Crawling Guidance

Public pages, user profiles, and active ads are intended to be discoverable. Login, registration, profile settings, admin screens, and authenticated user areas are not intended for indexing.
